name: Historic Centres of Stralsund and Wismar
description: Stralsund and Wismar are two Baltic ports in northern Germany that grew rich as Hanseatic League trading towns, then spent more than a century under Swedish rule. Their old centres are full of red-brick Gothic churches, merchants' houses and Stralsund's ornate town hall. St Mary's Church in Stralsund was once the tallest church in the world.
